== Era inventories and count conventions ==

The index groups each catalogue entry under its era, with named Legacy releases grouped beneath their parent Blocks. Blocks 6–9 link as parent headings rather than duplicate product rows. The independent Reflections Gold Remastered entry remains separate from Decipher's unreleased Reflections Gold project. The Death Star II starter distinction is preserved.

Dates describe releases, tournament legality, reorganization or planned publication as identified in each cell. A surviving sheet's revision date is not automatically its release date. Card counts distinguish product contents and editions: Decipher premiums and foils, Original and Legacy sheets, and Modern's current distinct-card roster are not one interchangeable count measure. Modern's roster observation is dated 13 November 2026 and groups alternate images and both faces of a card once; it is not asserted to be the original launch total or the currently legal format pool.

Blank cells retain unresolved dates or counts. Detailed source discrepancies and missing product destinations are recorded at [[Talk:Decipher era]], [[Talk:Virtual Original]], [[Talk:Virtual Legacy]] and [[Talk:Virtual Modern]]. Modern's demo teaching products are listed separately, while the Premium Demo cards are represented within Set P once.
